clue.text: Torture chamber at the restaurant?

definitions.meaning: a chamber for grilling, interrogating someone harshly, read whimsically
a dining room specialising in grilled meat

explanation.definitionFit: A dining room serving grilled food, which read literally sounds like a place of harsh interrogation.

clue.text: Appreciate how to make money

definitions.meaning: to appreciate is to understand or become aware of something
to convert assets into cash, as when selling property for its value

explanation.definitionFit: To grasp a fact fully is one sense; turning property into cash by selling it is the financial sense of the same verb.

clue.text: Kind to allow another nine inside

indicators.note: inside tells us one piece sits within the word for allowing

parts.note: to allow means to let

indicators.note: another suggests a different version of the word nine, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone generous enough to let nine more people come in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' is an unusual anagram signal: a different version of nine. 'inside' is the container signal; 'Kind' is the adjective, not a noun meaning type.
explanation.definitionFit: A kind person is gentle and forgiving rather than strict, which is what lenient describes.

clue.text: Way round town

parts.note: a road that circles a town so traffic can bypass its centre

explanation.definitionFit: A bypass road forming a loop about a town lets drivers avoid its centre.

clue.text: Girl turns tail at the yacht station

indicators.note: turns tail means only the tail end of the girl's name, its final pair of letters, is turned round

parts.note: Marian is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl turns and walks away from where the boats are moored.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns tail' swaps the last two letters of MARIAN, giving NA at the end instead of AN.
explanation.definitionFit: A harbour with moorings for yachts and pleasure boats is the meaning here.

clue.text: One skilled in versification is an expert thus with the girl's model

parts.note: an expert is a pro, short for professional
thus means so
Di is a girl's name, so the girl's is Di's
the Model T was Ford's famous car

explanation.surface: A poetry expert credited with modelling himself on a certain girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Prosody is the study of metre and rhythm in verse, and a specialist in it handles versification.

clue.text: Trojan mistook as being the attendant

indicators.note: mistook suggests the letters have been got wrong and so jumbled

parts.note: a man of Troy; the fodder the setter meant also includes an I beside these six letters

explanation.surface: Someone from Troy mistakenly took on the role of a servant.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters of Trojan give only six of the seven needed; the answer needs an extra I, perhaps lost from the clue as held.
explanation.definitionFit: A caretaker or doorkeeper attends to a building, so a janitor is an attendant.

clue.text: Reeled, but not all at the same time

definitions.text: not all at the same time
definitions.meaning: arranged so that start times are spread out, as with working hours

explanation.definitionFit: Tottering drunkenly is one sense; spreading out times, as with shifts or a race start, is the other.

clue.text: Be a star performing side by side

indicators.note: performing suggests the letters are put through their paces into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to go out and be a star on stage, side by side with another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performing' rearranges BE A STAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people level with each other, walking alongside, are said to walk this way.

clue.text: Longing but not starting to be receiving wages

indicators.note: not starting tells us the first letter of the word for longing is dropped

parts.note: longing means yearning

explanation.surface: Someone longing for something but not yet getting paid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but not starting' removes the Y from YEARNING.
explanation.definitionFit: To be paid a wage for work done is to be getting an income.

clue.text: Giving out that one's taking another to court

parts.note: one is I, so one's is I'S
taking someone to court means suing them

explanation.surface: Explaining that someone is distributing something while taking another party to court.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue is to distribute or hand out, as with tickets or statements.

clue.text: Discovery almost made by Andrew turns out to be very subtle

indicators.note: almost means the word for discovery loses its last letter

parts.note: a discovery is a find

indicators.note: turns out suggests the letters of Andrew are turned into a new order

explanation.surface: A discovery almost made by a man named Andrew turns out to be very subtle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims FIND to FIN; 'turns out' rearranges ANDREW to EDRAWN.
explanation.definitionFit: Something drawn out very fine is delicate, hence extremely subtle in distinction.

clue.text: Spun round earth, so to speak

indicators.note: so to speak indicates the word for earth is to be spoken, giving a similar sound

parts.note: the earth is the world

explanation.surface: Something spun round the earth, as one might say.
explanation.walkthrough: In non-rhotic British speech WORLD and the answer sound alike.
explanation.definitionFit: To whirl is to spin rapidly, so the past tense means spun round.

clue.text: Good-looking worker has a few

parts.note: a hand is a worker, as in farmhand
a few means some

explanation.surface: An attractive worker who has a few things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Attractive in appearance, especially of a man, is the meaning.

clue.text: Girl out of breath

indicators.note: out of here signals the letters of breath being knocked out of order

explanation.surface: A girl who is out of breath after running.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' rearranges BREATH.
explanation.definitionFit: Bertha is a girl's name.

clue.text: Players getting on with the first aid

parts.note: musical players form a band
getting on means growing older, aging

explanation.surface: Elderly musicians helping with first aid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrapping a wound with dressings is a basic part of emergency treatment.

clue.text: Only a fraction towards making a love-knot?

definitions.text: Only a fraction towards making a love-knot?

parts.words: Only a fraction towards making a love-knot?
parts.note: a part-way stage toward getting married, a fraction of tying the knot, read as the name of a simple knot

explanation.definitionFit: A simple knot used by sailors, whose name splits into a fraction and a word for getting wed.

clue.text: Aim to put clothes on after the commercial

indicators.note: after tells us the clothing word comes after the commercial

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
to put clothes on is to dress

explanation.surface: Planning to get dressed once the commercial break is over.
explanation.definitionFit: To aim at a problem is to direct effort at it, just as one may tackle or direct oneself at it.

clue.text: Bill taken in by Spanish gentle man briefly produces melody for religious places

indicators.note: taken in by shows the bill goes inside the abbreviation for the Spanish gentleman

parts.note: Sr is the short form of Señor, a Spanish gentleman
AC is short for account, a bill
an aria is a melody

explanation.surface: A Spanish gentleman takes in a bill and sings a melody about churches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'produces' is a link. A sacrarium is a sanctuary in a church, and these are its plural.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanctuaries round altars are sacred places within churches, hence religious places.

clue.text: Sounds like the rod is heavy for a Middle Easterner

indicators.note: sounds like tells us the phrase is spoken to give a similar sound

parts.note: the rod is a cue, as in snooker, and heavy means weighty

explanation.surface: A complaint that a fishing rod or rod-like object is too heavy.
explanation.walkthrough: CUE WEIGHTY spoken aloud gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Kuwait, a Gulf state, is from the Middle East.

clue.text: Wait for a race to finish

parts.note: the TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man
finish means end

explanation.surface: Waiting around for a race to be over.
explanation.walkthrough: The TT is the Isle of Man motorcycle race. 'for' and 'to' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: To wait on someone is to serve them, an old sense also meaning to look after.

clue.text: Model short time worker was permitted

parts.note: a temp works for a short time
let is past tense of let, so was permitted fits a passive sense

explanation.surface: A temporary worker allowed to act as a model.
explanation.definitionFit: A pattern or gauge used as a guide for shaping things, also spelt template.

clue.text: It is not an employer who runs one over

indicators.note: over signals the letters being turned over into a different order

explanation.surface: A careless driver, not an employer, who runs someone over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'who' is a link; 'over' rearranges RUNS ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: To employ is to use, so one who does not employ something is not a user of it.

clue.text: The sound of massed artillery if murder has somehow been committed

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters reach their order in some undefined way

explanation.surface: Gunfire heard when a murder has been committed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges IF MURDER; 'has been committed' is padding as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Continuous heavy gunfire sounds like a rolling of drums.

clue.text: Most unusual for artist to take a break

parts.note: RA stands for Royal Academician, an artist
to take a break is to rest

explanation.surface: It is most unusual for an artist to take a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' and 'to' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Rare means uncommon, so the superlative means least common.

clue.text: A party with navy personnel taking time for decoration

parts.note: a do is a party
RN is the Royal Navy
personnel are men

explanation.surface: A party attended by naval staff to decorate the place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with', 'taking' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: An ornament or embellishment is something added for beauty.

clue.text: One must have been at work before the window-cleaner can come round

definitions.text: One must have been at work before the window-cleaner can come round

parts.words: One must have been at work before the window-cleaner can come round
parts.note: a tradesman who puts glass in panes, without whose work there is nothing for a cleaner to wipe

explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman fitting window glass must work first, or there are no panes to clean.

clue.text: Ingenuous despite using skill on the continental ship

parts.note: skill means art
le is French for the, the article used on the Continent
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: A naive person who uses skill on a European ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'despite using' and 'on' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive and simple, without cunning, is the sense of both words.

clue.text: Comments coming from another section

indicators.note: another suggests a different arrangement of the word section

explanation.surface: Remarks coming from a different section of a newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' rearranges SECTION; 'coming from' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Reviews or remarks published about a performance are what the plural can mean.

clue.text: Soldiers hurried with more soldiers and artillerymen on hearing sound of trumpet

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army
hurried means ran
another TA, the Territorial Army
RA is the Royal Artillery

explanation.surface: Soldiers rush out when they hear a trumpet sounding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with', 'and' and 'on hearing' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: An imitation of a bugle fanfare is the meaning.
